title: Seafoam_Islands
lead_summary: Seafoam Islands splits Route 20 into a Western section (which eventually leads to Cinnabar Island) and an eastern section (which leads to Route 19).
missable_warnings: NOTE: Contains actions that alter player Karma.

items.name: Ice Heal

items.name: Big Pearl

items.name: TM07 Hail
